messages:
violet: quick pass on the Quickstart before the workshop: noticed a few small but user-facing inconsistencies — the 'hello' template still references REDWOOD_KEY, the TypeScript example uses generate() instead of chat.create(), and the quick link to the deploy checklist 404s. opening a single thread to coordinate a tiny batch patch.

omar: thanks for catching. can you paste the exact snippets/links you hit? i'll take the TS snippet + migration note.

violet: TS snippet currently:```ts
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'
const client = new Redwood(process.env.REDWOOD_KEY)
const out = await client.generate({ prompt: 'Hello' })
```
and link -> https://docs.redwood.ai/deploy/checklist (404). also the README in starter-apps still shows REDWOOD_KEY in the env examples.

rana: i'll sweep for REDWOOD_KEY/OLD_KEY across docs and starter repos and open a single PR to rename to RW_API_KEY and fix absolute links.

morgan: i'll open a small PR for the TS snippet to demonstrate chat.create with proper typing and a one-line migration callout at the top of quickstart. suggested snippet:```ts
import Redwood, { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference'
const client: RedwoodClient = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY })
const res = await client.chat.create({ model: 'redwood/fast', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Hello' }] })
console.log(res.output)
```
add a short box: "Upgrading from older examples: REDWOOD_KEY -> RW_API_KEY; generate() -> chat.create()" with links to a migration guide.

docs-bot: created issue #678: "quickstart: env rename + TS snippet + deploy link" assigned to rana and morgan.

rana: PR #4020 opened: repo sweep (REDWOOD_KEY -> RW_API_KEY), updated starter-apps README, and replaced /deploy/checklist -> /quickstart/deploy. included link-check and mdlint.

morgan: PR #4021 opened: TS snippet + migration callout. kept copy compact and added the one-line secrets recommendation (CI secrets or secret manager).

ci-bot: PR #4020 link-check found one remaining absolute docs URL in legacy/README.md. rana will patch.

rana: fixed stray URL in #4020, pushed.

ci-bot: both PRs passed checks.

omar: reviewing copy now, tiny nit: prefer "store RW_API_KEY in CI secrets or a secrets manager" wording. morgan can you adjust?

morgan: pushed the wording tweak.

docs-bot: PR #4020 and PR #4021 merged. Docs deploy queued.

ci-bot: Docs deploy succeeded. staging: https://docs.redwood.ai/quickstart updated.

violet: spot-checked staging: TS snippet uses chat.create, RW_API_KEY appears everywhere, and deploy link resolves. thanks everyone — closing thread. :white_check_mark:
